definition: From-scratch training recipe, not a designated checkpoint or inherited weight source

course.reference_warmup: One shuffled traversal of all1470 training rows per interval; supervised endpoint targets and visible teacher role/contact/cell plans; predicted region head supervised
course.teacher_plan_probability: For interval s>100: clamp((800-s)/500,0,1); mask out plans whose required heightmap cells are invisible
course.teacher_conditioning: Plan only; future demonstrated q is a loss target, not predictor forward input or generated-state feedback
course.initial_statistics: Joint output bias = mean training joint targets; region prior = log(training counts+1); no validation/test rows in either statistic

feedback_contract.generated_input: Exact raw predicted q committed only after existing endpoint acceptance
feedback_contract.failed_prediction: Output contributes loss; preserve the complete pre-prediction input and target for retry
feedback_contract.resampling: From training rows only, on demonstrated chain completion or after64 prediction attempts per slot
feedback_contract.attempts_count: Every prediction, including failures; persistent across reporting intervals

data.split_rule: train heights0.95/1.00/1.05; validation0.90; test1.10; nonoverlapping row indices
data.source_scope: 207 augmentations of one original climb00 source; source-motion independence not established

contact_and_evaluation_contract.contact_truth: Current Newton/MJWarp actual CONSTRAINT type and dist<actual includemargin; allocation checked; shared actual-primary-horizontal-face selection
contact_and_evaluation_contract.query_checkpoint_role: Loads saved physical scene/solver configuration only; no policy action inference or predictor weight inheritance
contact_and_evaluation_contract.unified_contact_objective: Existing actual gap interval and full-body safety objective unchanged
contact_and_evaluation_contract.endpoint_evaluation: Raw self-fed predictor, fresh current contact query and heightmap; no future q, teacher plan, event index, infiller, projector or pose correction
contact_and_evaluation_contract.support_load_slip_status: unknown without an executed trajectory and measured loads
contact_and_evaluation_contract.heldout_generalization: Not established; original source shared across height splits

recursive_case.failure: Left knee contact is retained while the demonstrated endpoint requires only the two hands
recursive_case.selection_scope: Compared only steps725,925,1100 on this training case; no independent held-out recursive selection
recursive_case.post_demo_reference: Final demonstrated pose held for display; no future ground truth
rollout_inputs: fresh Newton current contacts and anchors
recursive_case.support_load_slip_status: unknown; endpoint-only evaluation without executed trajectory

step925_example.role: Historical visualization and comparison result; not required as initialization, target model or reference checkpoint for the recipe

initialization_contract.read_only_audit_checkpoint: explicit audit only; exits before optimizer construction

archive.reason: User designated latest v1 recipe and step1000 checkpoint as current baseline; preserve historical evidence
